[[Goldenrod City]] }} (Japanese: '''ジバコイル、撃つ''' ''{{tt|Jibacoil|Magnezone}}, Shoot'') is the 612th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 17th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Brandon]], standing beside his {{DL|Brandon's legendary giants|Regirock}}, calls [[Palmer]] to share an update on the attempt to destroy the [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteor]]. When Palmer asks how he can help, Brandon urges him to stay at home with his {{adv|Pearl|son}}. Brandon reveals that he and the other [[Hoenn]] [[Frontier Brain]]s defeated the {{tc|Aqua Admin|Team Aqua}} and {{tc|Magma Admin|Team Magma Admin}}s by the sea. The Frontier Brains are shown next to Brandon as they interrogate the Admins. [[Anabel]] hears a voice call out her name, and she is surprised to see {{adv|Emerald}} speaking from a portal above her. Emerald asks her if she has seen {{adv|Sapphire}} nearby, but the Frontier Brains tells him that they haven't. Emerald shouts a quick goodbye, then asks {{p|Hoopa}} to make a portal to the [[Mossdeep Space Center]]. Hoopa creates another portal, but it shows an [[Aarune|unknown man]] inside of a cave. As Emerald berates Hoopa for not listening, he doesn't notice the man approach a {{DL|Decoration|Generation VI decorations|tent}}. Resting inside the tent, Sapphire can be seen. The man introduces himself to her as Aarune, and tells her that they are in a [[Secret Base]] off of {{rt|120|Hoenn}}. Aarune explains that he was helping a boy build his Secret Base when he saw Sapphire and her [[Troppy|Tropius]] fall from the sky. Aarune is interrupted by a muffled voice coming from outside of the tent. Sapphire follows the sound, and is shocked to see Emerald through a portal. Emerald is equally shocked to see Sapphire. Before he can say anything, he is distracted by {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} bursting into the area. [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]] reveal that the [[Legendary Pokémon]] have mastered {{m|Origin Pulse}} and {{m|Precipice Blades}}. Upon seeing the powerful Pokémon, Hoopa grows competitive and forms a new portal. As {{adv|Ruby}} is still in {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}'s grip, a portal appears in front of them. Before Ruby and {{adv|Norman}} can enter the portal with Rayquaza, the [[Primal Reversion|primal forms]] of Kyogre and Groudon can be seen through it. Rayquaza knocks Norman from his {{p|Staraptor}}, then fires a powerful beam into the portal. The beam hits Kyogre and Groudon, and when they prepare to retaliate, the {{OBP|Elder|Meteor Village}} urges everyone to calm Rayquaza. Panicked, Hoopa places the other portal next to the one Rayquaza is about to emerge from. When Rayquaza enters through it, it is transported to the Secret Base. Sapphire is shocked as Rayquaza flies past her and into the sky above Route 120. She is even more shocked when she sees Ruby trapped in its claw. When Ruby tries to direct Rayquaza toward {{rt|131|Hoenn}}, it drops him, sending him plummeting from the sky. As Ruby falls to his certain death, he regrets failing to save the world, as well as never apologizing to Sapphire. To his surprise, he lands on an {{p|Altaria}}. He looks up to see {{adv|Wally}}, who is riding on a {{p|Magnezone}} in front of him. Wally reveals that he is the owner of the Secret Base that Rayquaza had flown out of. Seeing that Ruby needs help, Wally commands his Magnezone to use {{m|Discharge}} against Rayquaza. As Magnezone batters Rayquaza with attacks, Ruby is stunned to see how strong of a {{pkmn|Trainer}} Wally has become. When Wally has Rayquaza calmed, Ruby raises the [[Jade Orb|Green Orb]] in front of it. He urges Rayquaza to join him to destroy the meteor, and to his joy, Rayquaza agrees. Ruby realizes there is someone above him, and looks up to see Sapphire on Troppy's back. The two meet each other's eyes. ==Major events== * The Hoenn [[Frontier Brain]]s defeat the [[Admin]]s of Neo [[Team Magma]] and Neo [[Team Aqua]]. * {{adv|Sapphire}} wakes up inside a [[Secret Base]] on {{rt|120|Hoenn}}, where she meets [[Aarune]]. * Aarune reveals that he rescued Sapphire after her defeat and healed her [[Troppy]] at a [[Pokémon Center]]. * {{adv|Emerald}} locates Sapphire through {{p|Hoopa}}'s ring. * [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]] emerge from their training space, having finished their training with {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}}. * {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Norman}} use Hoopa's ring to return to the [[Meteor Village]]. * When {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}} sees Groudon and Kyogre through Hoopa's ring, it goes wild and throws Norman off of its back. * Rayquaza attempts to attack Groudon and Kyogre, only for Hoopa to use its rings to send Rayquaza to Sapphire's location. * Ruby is thrown far away by Rayquaza, but is saved by {{adv|Wally}}. * Wally battles Rayquaza in an attempt to subdue it, but is stopped by Ruby. * Ruby attempts to reason with Rayquaza, only to notice that Sapphire has appeared in front of him. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Aarune]] ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * {{adv|Emerald}} * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Norman}} * {{adv|Wally}} * [[Noland]] * [[Greta]] * [[Tucker]] * [[Lucy]] * [[Spenser]] * [[Anabel]] * [[Brandon]] * [[Palmer]] * [[Maxie]] * [[Archie]] * [[Tabitha]] (ORAS) * [[Courtney]] (ORAS) * [[Shelly]] (ORAS) * [[Matt]] (ORAS) * [[Aarune]] * [[Tomatoma]] * {{OBP|Elder|Meteor Village}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Tropius}} ([[Troppy]]/{{tt|Pilo|Chuang Yi}};
